screening_decisions.reason: This is an observational/retrospective study analyzing complications from 5,851 consecutively induced abortions. It is not a randomized controlled trial and does not compare different surgical methods.

This is a randomized study comparing conventional vacuum aspiration (VA) vs manual vacuum aspiration (MVA) in 200 women with gestational age <56 days. Meets all criteria: RCT, compares different surgical methods, first trimester abortion.

This is a historical/observational study comparing mortality and morbidity data before and after Roe v Wade using data from National Center for Health Statistics, CDC, and other databases. It is not a randomized controlled trial and does not compare different surgical methods.

This is a randomized trial but compares prostaglandin suppository vs placebo (medical cervical preparation), not different surgical methods. All patients received vacuum aspiration; the intervention is medical preparation, not surgical technique.

This is a randomized study comparing dilatation and curettage (D&C) vs vacuum aspiration in 420 women at 6-12 weeks gestation. Meets all criteria: RCT, compares different surgical methods, first trimester abortion.

This is a randomized trial comparing manual vacuum aspiration vs electric vacuum aspiration in 84 women at <10 weeks gestation. Meets all criteria: RCT, compares different surgical methods, first trimester abortion.

This is a randomized study comparing manual vacuum aspiration (MVA) vs electric vacuum aspiration (EVA) in 127 women for first trimester abortion. Meets all criteria: RCT, compares different surgical methods, first trimester abortion.

This study compares vacuum aspiration vs classical dilatation and curettage in 47 women, but there is no mention of randomization. The abstract describes groups (23 vs 24) but does not state they were randomly assigned.

This is a randomized study comparing metal vs flexible plastic cannulae for vacuum aspiration in 300 subjects at 7-10 weeks gestation. While both are vacuum aspiration, the cannulae type represents a different surgical technique. Meets criteria: RCT, compares different surgical methods, first trimester abortion.

This is a randomized trial comparing manual vacuum aspirator vs electric vacuum curettage devices in 114 women undergoing first-trimester abortions. Meets all criteria: RCT, compares different surgical methods, first trimester abortion.
